models_evaluated: FedMentor (LoRA + domain-aware differential privacy federated fine-tuning)
unlisted_practices: Federated fine-tuning of LLMs so patient data stays on client devices
Domain-aware differential privacy noise calibrated to data sensitivity per client
Adaptive server-side reduction of DP noise when utility falls below a threshold

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel federated fine-tuning and differential privacy algorithm (FedMentor) across mental health benchmark datasets, evaluating model safety and utility. A newly proposed training framework is not an evaluated deployment practice.
